verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י רָעָב֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ מִלְּבַד֙ הָרָעָ֣ב הָרִאשׁ֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה בִּימֵ֣י אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַיֵּ֧לֶךְ יִצְחָ֛ק אֶל־ אֲבִימֶּ֥לֶךְ מֶֽלֶךְ־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים גְּרָֽרָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî rā·‘āḇ bā·’ā·reṣ mil·lə·ḇaḏ hā·rā·‘āḇ hā·ri·šō·wn ’ă·šer hā·yāh bî·mê ’aḇ·rā·hām way·yê·leḵ yiṣ·ḥāq ’el- ʾă·ḇīm·mɛ·lɛḵ me·leḵ- pə·liš·tîm gə·rā·rāh
verses.literal: Now there was another famine in the land subsequent to the one . . . that had occurred in Abraham’s time And Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines at Gerar

verses.original: וַיֵּרָ֤א אֵלָיו֙ יְהוָ֔ה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אַל־ תֵּרֵ֣ד מִצְרָ֑יְמָה שְׁכֹ֣ן בָּאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֹמַ֥ר אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·rā ’ê·lāw Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’al- tê·rêḏ miṣ·rā·yə·māh šə·ḵōn bā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ’ō·mar ’ê·le·ḵā
verses.literal: The LORD appeared to Isaac and said Do not go down to Egypt Settle in the land where I tell you . . .

verses.original: גּ֚וּר בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את וְאֶֽהְיֶ֥ה עִמְּךָ֖ וַאֲבָרְכֶ֑ךָּ כִּֽי־ לְךָ֣ וּֽלְזַרְעֲךָ֗ אֶתֵּן֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָֽאֲרָצֹ֣ת הָאֵ֔ל וַהֲקִֽמֹתִי֙ אֶת־ הַשְּׁבֻעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖עְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם אָבִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: gūr bā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ wə·’eh·yeh ‘im·mə·ḵā wa·’ă·ḇā·rə·ḵe·kā kî- lə·ḵā ū·lə·zar·‘ă·ḵā ’et·tên ’eṯ- kāl- hā·’ă·rā·ṣōṯ hā·’êl wa·hă·qi·mō·ṯî ’eṯ- haš·šə·ḇu·‘āh ’ă·šer niš·ba‘·tî lə·’aḇ·rā·hām ’ā·ḇî·ḵā
verses.literal: Stay in this land as a foreigner and I will be with you and bless you For I will give all these lands to you and your offspring and I will confirm the oath that I swore to your father Abraham

verses.original: וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֤י אֶֽת־ זַרְעֲךָ֙ כְּכוֹכְבֵ֣י הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְנָתַתִּ֣י לְזַרְעֲךָ֔ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הָאֲרָצֹ֖ת הָאֵ֑ל וְהִתְבָּרֲכ֣וּ בְזַרְעֲךָ֔ כֹּ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hir·bê·ṯî ’eṯ- zar·‘ă·ḵā kə·ḵō·wḵ·ḇê haš·šā·ma·yim wə·nā·ṯat·tî lə·zar·‘ă·ḵā ’êṯ kāl- hā·’ă·rā·ṣōṯ hā·’êl wə·hiṯ·bā·ră·ḵū ḇə·zar·‘ă·ḵā kōl gō·w·yê hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and I will give them all these lands and through your offspring all nations of the earth will be blessed

verses.original: עֵ֕קֶב אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁמַ֥ע אַבְרָהָ֖ם בְּקֹלִ֑י וַיִּשְׁמֹר֙ מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֔י מִצְוֺתַ֖י חֻקּוֹתַ֥י וְתוֹרֹתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·qeḇ ’ă·šer- šā·ma‘ ’aḇ·rā·hām bə·qō·lî way·yiš·mōr miš·mar·tî miṣ·wō·ṯay ḥuq·qō·w·ṯay wə·ṯō·w·rō·ṯāy
verses.literal: because Abraham listened to My voice and kept My charge My commandments My statutes and My laws

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב יִצְחָ֖ק בִּגְרָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·šeḇ yiṣ·ḥāq biḡ·rār
verses.literal: So Isaac settled in Gerar

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁאֲל֞וּ אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמָּקוֹם֙ לְאִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֲחֹ֣תִי הִ֑וא כִּ֤י יָרֵא֙ לֵאמֹ֣ר אִשְׁתִּ֔י פֶּן־ יַֽהַרְגֻ֜נִי אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמָּקוֹם֙ עַל־ רִבְקָ֔ה כִּֽי־ טוֹבַ֥ת מַרְאֶ֖ה הִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·’ă·lū ’an·šê ham·mā·qō·wm lə·’iš·tōw way·yō·mer ’ă·ḥō·ṯî hî kî yā·rê lê·mōr ’iš·tî pen- ya·har·ḡu·nî ’an·šê ham·mā·qō·wm ‘al- riḇ·qāh kî- ṭō·w·ḇaṯ mar·’eh hî
verses.literal: But when the men of that place asked about his wife he said She is my sister For he was afraid to say She is my wife since he thought to himself The men of this place will kill me on account of Rebekah because she is so beautiful . . .

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כִּ֣י אָֽרְכוּ־ ל֥וֹ שָׁם֙ הַיָּמִ֔ים וַיַּשְׁקֵ֗ף אֲבִימֶ֙לֶךְ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים בְּעַ֖ד הַֽחַלּ֑וֹן וַיַּ֗רְא וְהִנֵּ֤ה יִצְחָק֙ מְצַחֵ֔ק אֵ֖ת רִבְקָ֥ה אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kî ’ā·rə·ḵū- lōw šām hay·yā·mîm way·yaš·qêp̄ ’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ me·leḵ pə·liš·tîm bə·‘aḏ ha·ḥal·lō·wn way·yar wə·hin·nêh yiṣ·ḥāq mə·ṣa·ḥêq ’êṯ riḇ·qāh ’iš·tōw
verses.literal: When . . . Isaac had been there a long time Abimelech king of the Philistines looked down from the window and was surprised to see . . . Isaac caressing . . . his wife Rebekah

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א אֲבִימֶ֜לֶךְ לְיִצְחָ֗ק וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אַ֣ךְ הִנֵּ֤ה אִשְׁתְּךָ֙ הִ֔וא וְאֵ֥יךְ אָמַ֖רְתָּ אֲחֹ֣תִי הִ֑וא וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ יִצְחָ֔ק כִּ֣י אָמַ֔רְתִּי פֶּן־ אָמ֖וּת עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ lə·yiṣ·ḥāq way·yō·mer ’aḵ hin·nêh ’iš·tə·ḵā hî wə·’êḵ ’ā·mar·tā ’ă·ḥō·ṯî hî way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw yiṣ·ḥāq kî ’ā·mar·tî pen- ’ā·mūṯ ‘ā·le·hā
verses.literal: Abimelech sent for Isaac and said So she is really . . . your wife How could you say She is my sister Isaac replied . . . Because I thought I might die on account of her

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ מַה־ זֹּ֖את עָשִׂ֣יתָ לָּ֑נוּ כִּ֠מְעַט שָׁכַ֞ב אַחַ֤ד הָעָם֙ אֶת־ אִשְׁתֶּ֔ךָ וְהֵבֵאתָ֥ עָלֵ֖ינוּ אָשָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ mah- zōṯ ‘ā·śî·ṯā lā·nū kim·‘aṭ šā·ḵaḇ ’a·ḥaḏ hā·‘ām ’eṯ- ’iš·te·ḵā wə·hê·ḇê·ṯā ‘ā·lê·nū ’ā·šām
verses.literal: What is this you have done to us asked Abimelech One of the people could easily have slept with your wife and you would have brought guilt upon us

verses.original: וַיְצַ֣ו אֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר הַנֹּגֵ֜עַ בָּאִ֥ישׁ הַזֶּ֛ה וּבְאִשְׁתּ֖וֹ מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw ’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ ’eṯ- kāl- hā·‘ām lê·mōr han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bā·’îš haz·zeh ū·ḇə·’iš·tōw mō·wṯ yū·māṯ
verses.literal: So Abimelech warned all the people saying Whoever harms this man or his wife will surely be put to death . . .

verses.original: וַיִּזְרַ֤ע יִצְחָק֙ בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַהִ֔וא וַיִּמְצָ֛א בַּשָּׁנָ֥ה הַהִ֖וא מֵאָ֣ה שְׁעָרִ֑ים וַֽיְבָרֲכֵ֖הוּ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·ra‘ yiṣ·ḥāq bā·’ā·reṣ ha·hi·w way·yim·ṣā baš·šā·nāh ha·hi·w mê·’āh šə·‘ā·rîm way·ḇā·ră·ḵê·hū Yah·weh
verses.literal: Now Isaac sowed seed in the land and that very year he reaped a hundredfold . . . And the LORD blessed him

verses.original: וַיִּגְדַּ֖ל הָאִ֑ישׁ וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ הָלוֹךְ֙ וְגָדֵ֔ל עַ֥ד כִּֽי־ גָדַ֖ל מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḡ·dal hā·’îš way·yê·leḵ hā·lō·wḵ wə·ḡā·ḏêl ‘aḏ kî- ḡā·ḏal mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: and he became richer and richer . . . until . . . . . . he was exceedingly wealthy

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־ ל֤וֹ מִקְנֵה־ צֹאן֙ וּמִקְנֵ֣ה בָקָ֔ר וַעֲבֻדָּ֖ה רַבָּ֑ה וַיְקַנְא֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî- lōw miq·nêh- ṣōn ū·miq·nêh ḇā·qār wa·‘ă·ḇud·dāh rab·bāh way·qan·’ū ’ō·ṯōw pə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: He owned so many flocks . . . and herds . . . and servants that the Philistines envied him

verses.original: וְכָל־ הַבְּאֵרֹ֗ת אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָֽפְרוּ֙ עַבְדֵ֣י אָבִ֔יו בִּימֵ֖י אַבְרָהָ֣ם אָבִ֑יו סִתְּמ֣וּם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַיְמַלְא֖וּם עָפָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl hab·bə·’ê·rōṯ ’ă·šer ḥā·p̄ə·rū ‘aḇ·ḏê ’ā·ḇîw bî·mê ’aḇ·rā·hām ’ā·ḇîw sit·tə·mūm pə·liš·tîm way·mal·’ūm ‘ā·p̄ār
verses.literal: So the Philistines took dirt and stopped up all the wells that his father’s servants had dug in the days of his father Abraham

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֖לֶךְ אֶל־ יִצְחָ֑ק לֵ֚ךְ מֵֽעִמָּ֔נוּ כִּֽי־ עָצַֽמְתָּ־ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ ’el- yiṣ·ḥāq lêḵ mê·‘im·mā·nū kî- ‘ā·ṣam·tā- mim·men·nū mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: Then Abimelech said to Isaac Depart from us for you are much too powerful for us

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ מִשָּׁ֖ם יִצְחָ֑ק וַיִּ֥חַן בְּנַֽחַל־ גְּרָ֖ר וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ miš·šām yiṣ·ḥāq way·yi·ḥan bə·na·ḥal- gə·rār way·yê·šeḇ šām
verses.literal: So Isaac left that place and encamped in the Valley of Gerar and settled there

verses.original: וַיָּ֨שָׁב יִצְחָ֜ק וַיַּחְפֹּ֣ר׀ אֶת־ בְּאֵרֹ֣ת הַמַּ֗יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָֽפְרוּ֙ בִּימֵי֙ אַבְרָהָ֣ם אָבִ֔יו וַיְסַתְּמ֣וּם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אַחֲרֵ֖י מ֣וֹת אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֤א לָהֶן֙ שֵׁמ֔וֹת כַּשֵּׁמֹ֕ת אֲשֶׁר־ קָרָ֥א לָהֶ֖ן אָבִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ yiṣ·ḥāq way·yaḥ·pōr ’eṯ- bə·’ê·rōṯ ham·ma·yim ’ă·šer ḥā·p̄ə·rū bî·mê ’aḇ·rā·hām ’ā·ḇîw way·sat·tə·mūm pə·liš·tîm ’a·ḥă·rê mō·wṯ ’aḇ·rā·hām way·yiq·rā lā·hen šê·mō·wṯ kaš·šê·mōṯ ’ă·šer- qā·rā lā·hen ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: Isaac reopened . . . the wells . . . that had been dug in the days of his father Abraham which the Philistines had stopped up after Abraham died And he gave these wells the same names . . . his father had given them

verses.original: וַיַּחְפְּר֥וּ עַבְדֵֽי־ יִצְחָ֖ק בַּנָּ֑חַל וַיִּ֨מְצְאוּ־ שָׁ֔ם בְּאֵ֖ר מַ֥יִם חַיִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḥ·pə·rū ‘aḇ·ḏê- yiṣ·ḥāq ban·nā·ḥal way·yim·ṣə·’ū- šām bə·’êr ma·yim ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: Then Isaac’s servants dug in the valley and found a well of fresh water there

verses.original: וַיָּרִ֜יבוּ רֹעֵ֣י גְרָ֗ר עִם־ רֹעֵ֥י יִצְחָ֛ק לֵאמֹ֖ר לָ֣נוּ הַמָּ֑יִם וַיִּקְרָ֤א שֵֽׁם־ הַבְּאֵר֙ עֵ֔שֶׂק כִּ֥י הִֽתְעַשְּׂק֖וּ עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·rî·ḇū rō·‘ê ḡə·rār ‘im- rō·‘ê yiṣ·ḥāq lê·mōr lā·nū ham·mā·yim way·yiq·rā šêm- hab·bə·’êr ‘ê·śeq kî hiṯ·‘aś·śə·qū ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: But the herdsmen of Gerar quarreled with Isaac’s herdsmen and said The water is ours So he named . . . the well Esek because they contended with him

verses.original: וַֽיַּחְפְּרוּ֙ בְּאֵ֣ר אַחֶ֔רֶת וַיָּרִ֖יבוּ גַּם־ עָלֶ֑יהָ וַיִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמָ֖הּ שִׂטְנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḥ·pə·rū bə·’êr ’a·ḥe·reṯ way·yā·rî·ḇū gam- ‘ā·le·hā way·yiq·rā šə·māh śiṭ·nāh
verses.literal: Then they dug another well and quarreled over that one also so he named it Sitnah

verses.original: וַיַּעְתֵּ֣ק מִשָּׁ֗ם וַיַּחְפֹּר֙ בְּאֵ֣ר אַחֶ֔רֶת וְלֹ֥א רָב֖וּ עָלֶ֑יהָ וַיִּקְרָ֤א שְׁמָהּ֙ רְחֹב֔וֹת וַיֹּ֗אמֶר כִּֽי־ עַתָּ֞ה הִרְחִ֧יב יְהוָ֛ה לָ֖נוּ וּפָרִ֥ינוּ בָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya‘·têq miš·šām way·yaḥ·pōr bə·’êr ’a·ḥe·reṯ wə·lō rā·ḇū ‘ā·le·hā way·yiq·rā šə·māh rə·ḥō·ḇō·wṯ way·yō·mer kî- ‘at·tāh hir·ḥîḇ Yah·weh lā·nū ū·p̄ā·rî·nū ḇā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: He moved on from there and dug . . . another well and they did not quarrel over it He named it Rehoboth and said At last . . . the LORD has made room for us and we will be fruitful in the land

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַל מִשָּׁ֖ם בְּאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al miš·šām bə·’êr šā·ḇa‘
verses.literal: From there Isaac went up to Beersheba

verses.original: וַיֵּרָ֨א אֵלָ֤יו יְהוָה֙ בַּלַּ֣יְלָה הַה֔וּא וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אָנֹכִ֕י אֱלֹהֵ֖י אַבְרָהָ֣ם אָבִ֑יךָ אַל־ תִּירָא֙ כִּֽי־ אִתְּךָ֣ אָנֹ֔כִי וּבֵֽרַכְתִּ֙יךָ֙ וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֣י אֶֽת־ זַרְעֲךָ֔ בַּעֲב֖וּר אַבְרָהָ֥ם עַבְדִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·rā ’ê·lāw Yah·weh bal·lay·lāh ha·hū way·yō·mer ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ĕ·lō·hê ’aḇ·rā·hām ’ā·ḇî·ḵā ’al- tî·rā kî- ’it·tə·ḵā ’ā·nō·ḵî ū·ḇê·raḵ·tî·ḵā wə·hir·bê·ṯî ’eṯ- zar·‘ă·ḵā ba·‘ă·ḇūr ’aḇ·rā·hām ‘aḇ·dî
verses.literal: and that night the LORD appeared to him and said I am the God of your father Abraham Do not be afraid for I am with you I will bless you and multiply your descendants for the sake of My servant Abraham

verses.original: וַיִּ֧בֶן שָׁ֣ם מִזְבֵּ֗חַ וַיִּקְרָא֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה וַיֶּט־ שָׁ֖ם אָהֳל֑וֹ וַיִּכְרוּ־ שָׁ֥ם עַבְדֵי־ יִצְחָ֖ק בְּאֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen šām miz·bê·aḥ way·yiq·rā bə·šêm Yah·weh way·yeṭ- šām ’ā·ho·lōw way·yiḵ·rū- šām ‘aḇ·ḏê- yiṣ·ḥāq bə·’êr
verses.literal: So Isaac built an altar there and called on the name of the LORD and he pitched his tent there His servants also dug a well there

verses.original: וַאֲבִימֶ֕לֶךְ הָלַ֥ךְ אֵלָ֖יו מִגְּרָ֑ר וַאֲחֻזַּת֙ מֵֽרֵעֵ֔הוּ וּפִיכֹ֖ל שַׂר־ צְבָאֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ hā·laḵ ’ê·lāw mig·gə·rār wa·’ă·ḥuz·zaṯ mê·rê·‘ê·hū ū·p̄î·ḵōl śar- ṣə·ḇā·’ōw
verses.literal: Later, Abimelech came to Isaac from Gerar with Ahuzzath his adviser and Phicol the commander of his army

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ יִצְחָ֔ק מַדּ֖וּעַ בָּאתֶ֣ם אֵלָ֑י וְאַתֶּם֙ שְׂנֵאתֶ֣ם אֹתִ֔י וַתְּשַׁלְּח֖וּנִי מֵאִתְּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem yiṣ·ḥāq mad·dū·a‘ bā·ṯem ’ê·lāy wə·’at·tem śə·nê·ṯem ’ō·ṯî wat·tə·šal·lə·ḥū·nî mê·’it·tə·ḵem
verses.literal: Why have you come to me Isaac asked them You hated me and sent me away . . .

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ רָא֣וֹ רָאִינוּ֮ כִּֽי־ הָיָ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה׀ עִמָּךְ֒ וַנֹּ֗אמֶר תְּהִ֨י נָ֥א אָלָ֛ה בֵּינוֹתֵ֖ינוּ בֵּינֵ֣ינוּ וּבֵינֶ֑ךָ וְנִכְרְתָ֥ה בְרִ֖ית עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū rā·’ōw rā·’î·nū kî- hā·yāh Yah·weh ‘im·māḵ wan·nō·mer tə·hî nā ’ā·lāh bê·nō·w·ṯê·nū bê·nê·nū ū·ḇê·ne·ḵā wə·niḵ·rə·ṯāh ḇə·rîṯ ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: We can plainly see . . . that the LORD has been with you they replied We recommend that there should now be . . . an oath between us and you Let us make a covenant with you

verses.original: אִם־ תַּעֲשֵׂ֨ה עִמָּ֜נוּ רָעָ֗ה כַּאֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א נְגַֽעֲנ֔וּךָ וְכַאֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשִׂ֤ינוּ עִמְּךָ֙ רַק־ ט֔וֹב וַנְּשַׁלֵּֽחֲךָ֖ בְּשָׁל֑וֹם אַתָּ֥ה עַתָּ֖ה בְּר֥וּךְ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ta·ʿă·śēh ‘im·mā·nū rā·‘āh ka·’ă·šer lō nə·ḡa·‘ă·nū·ḵā wə·ḵa·’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·nū ‘im·mə·ḵā raq- ṭō·wḇ wan·nə·šal·lê·ḥă·ḵā bə·šā·lō·wm ’at·tāh ‘at·tāh bə·rūḵ Yah·weh
verses.literal: that you will not harm us just as we have not harmed you but have done only good to you sending you on your way in peace And now you are blessed by the LORD

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ לָהֶם֙ מִשְׁתֶּ֔ה וַיֹּאכְל֖וּ וַיִּשְׁתּֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś lā·hem miš·teh way·yō·ḵə·lū way·yiš·tū
verses.literal: So Isaac prepared a feast for them and they ate and drank

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכִּ֣ימוּ בַבֹּ֔קֶר וַיִּשָּׁבְע֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ לְאָחִ֑יו וַיְשַׁלְּחֵ֣ם יִצְחָ֔ק וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ מֵאִתּ֖וֹ בְּשָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·kî·mū ḇab·bō·qer way·yiš·šā·ḇə·‘ū ’îš lə·’ā·ḥîw way·šal·lə·ḥêm yiṣ·ḥāq way·yê·lə·ḵū mê·’it·tōw bə·šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: And they got up early the next morning and swore an oath to each other Then Isaac sent them on their way and they left him . . . in peace

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ עַבְדֵ֣י יִצְחָ֔ק וַיַּגִּ֣דוּ ל֔וֹ עַל־ אֹד֥וֹת הַבְּאֵ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָפָ֑רוּ וַיֹּ֥אמְרוּ ל֖וֹ מָצָ֥אנוּ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bay·yō·wm ha·hū way·yā·ḇō·’ū ‘aḇ·ḏê yiṣ·ḥāq way·yag·gi·ḏū lōw ‘al- ’ō·ḏō·wṯ hab·bə·’êr ’ă·šer ḥā·p̄ā·rū way·yō·mə·rū lōw mā·ṣā·nū mā·yim
verses.literal: On that same day Isaac’s servants came and told him about . . . the well they had dug We have found water they told him

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֹתָ֖הּ שִׁבְעָ֑ה עַל־ כֵּ֤ן שֵׁם־ הָעִיר֙ בְּאֵ֣ר שֶׁ֔בַע עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ’ō·ṯāh šiḇ·‘āh ‘al- kên šêm- hā·‘îr bə·’êr še·ḇa‘ ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: So he called it Shibah and to this day the name of the city is Beersheba

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י עֵשָׂו֙ בֶּן־ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וַיִּקַּ֤ח אִשָּׁה֙ אֶת־ יְהוּדִ֔ית בַּת־ בְּאֵרִ֖י הַֽחִתִּ֑י וְאֶת־ בָּ֣שְׂמַ֔ת בַּת־ אֵילֹ֖ן הַֽחִתִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ‘ê·śāw ben- ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh way·yiq·qaḥ ’iš·šāh ’eṯ- yə·hū·ḏîṯ baṯ- bə·’ê·rî ha·ḥit·tî wə·’eṯ- bā·śə·maṯ baṯ- ’ê·lōn ha·ḥit·tî
verses.literal: When Esau was forty years old . . . he took as his wives Judith daughter of Beeri the Hittite and Basemath daughter of Elon the Hittite

verses.original: וַתִּהְיֶ֖יןָ מֹ֣רַת ר֑וּחַ לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּלְרִבְקָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wat·tih·ye·nā mō·raṯ rū·aḥ lə·yiṣ·ḥāq ū·lə·riḇ·qāh
verses.literal: And they brought grief to Isaac and Rebekah
